warnings.message: Bundler: no exact version is pinned, so depcurfew configures for Bundler 4.0.23, the latest version it knows
warnings.fix: Pin the version you use (BUNDLED WITH in Gemfile.lock or a CI setup step) to configure for it

warnings.message: Bundler: cooldown not written: the source "https://rubygems.org" call on line 3 of Gemfile is not edited, because it has a block, so it is the source of the gems in the block only; depcurfew apply edits only a plain source "https://rubygems.org" call on a line of its own
warnings.fix: Add cooldown: 3 to that call by hand (source "https://rubygems.org", cooldown: 3 do), or write it as a plain call on a line of its own and run depcurfew apply again

warnings.message: Bundler: cooldown not written: the URL of the source call on line 1 of Gemfile is not a literal string, so depcurfew cannot tell whether it is "https://rubygems.org"
warnings.fix: If it names rubygems.org, write it as source "https://rubygems.org" on a line of its own and run depcurfew apply again, or add cooldown: 3 to that call by hand

warnings.message: Bundler: no setting exempts single gems from cooldown, so every gem waits; the exceptions of cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json name no Ruby gems and are not applied to Bundler
warnings.fix: Nothing to set for Bundler. To take a newer version of one gem sooner, review it and run bundle update GEM --cooldown 0 --conservative for that gem

warnings.message: Bundler builds the native extensions of gems when it installs them, which runs code of the gem (extconf.rb, a Rakefile), and has no setting that blocks this or allows it for some gems only, so installScripts "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Review gems with native extensions (extensions in the gemspec, an ext directory) before you add or update them; there is nothing to set for Bundler

warnings.message: Bundler has no setting for git dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Review new dependencies by hand; depcurfew doctor cannot see them in the lockfile either
